description: Fixed 35-entry colour palette of the OVT YUView statistics CSV exporter (chapter 06 §6.8.2, WI-0.089): mapColor values for OVT_IntraModeY/C, OVT_Ref0/1 (0..15), OVT_TxType, OVT_FilterIdx and OVT_PartitionType (value mod 35). Entry 0 white, 1 light grey, 2..34 a hue sweep with entry 26 (HEVC vertical) at 0,128,255. core/src/model/yuview_csv.cpp holds the same table; test_yuview_csv compares them.
